## Armor[]

Armour is one of the Protections which mitigates Hit Damage (double for Physical Damage) during Combat Calculations.

This damage reduction in multiplicative to the damage resistance.

Armor only reduces Damage from hits and not Damage over Time, the Formula can be found here: Epoch tools Armor

The Armor Effectivness for a Level 100 Area for every 10 Points of Armor can be seen here:
